verses.english: Linked Discourses 15.7
Chapter One
Disciples
At Sāvatthī.

verses.pali: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā …pe… ekamantaṁ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṁ etadavocuṁ:
verses.english: Then several mendicants went up to the Buddha … and asked him,

verses.pali: “kīvabahukā nu kho, bhante, kappā abbhatītā atikkantā”ti?
verses.english: “Sir, how many eons have passed?”
“Mendicants, many eons have passed.
It’s not easy to calculate

verses.pali: ‘ettakā kappā iti vā, ettakāni kappasatāni iti vā, ettakāni kappasahassāni iti vā, ettakāni kappasatasahassāni iti vā’”ti.
verses.english: how many eons have passed, how many hundreds or thousands or hundreds of thousands of eons.”
“But sir, is it possible to give a simile?”
“It’s possible,” said the Buddha.
“Suppose there were four disciples with a lifespan of a hundred years.

verses.pali: Te divase divase kappasatasahassaṁ kappasatasahassaṁ anussareyyuṁ.
verses.english: And each day they would each recollect a hundred thousand eons.

verses.pali: Ananussaritāva, bhikkhave, tehi kappā assu, atha kho te cattāro sāvakā vassasatāyukā vassasatajīvino vassasatassa accayena kālaṁ kareyyuṁ.
verses.english: Those four disciples would pass away after a hundred years and there would still be eons that they haven’t recollected.

verses.pali: Evaṁ bahukā kho, bhikkhave, kappā abbhatītā atikkantā.
verses.english: That’s how many eons have passed.
It’s not easy to calculate

verses.pali: ‘ettakā kappā iti vā, ettakāni kappasatāni iti vā, ettakāni kappasahassāni iti vā, ettakāni kappasatasahassāni iti vā’ti.
verses.english: how many eons have passed, how many hundreds or thousands or hundreds of thousands of eons.
Why is that?
This transmigration has no known beginning. …
This is quite enough for you to become disillusioned, dispassionate, and freed regarding all conditions.”
